apple.line: Give me spots on my apples
stanza: Hey farmer, farmer, put away the DDT now
Give me spots on my apples
But leave me the birds and the bees, please
Lover, when I sing my song
All the trees are gonna sing along
And bend their branches down to me
To lay their fruit around my feet
The almond and the apple
And the sugar from the maple
The trees gonna lay the wedding table

apple.songTitle: You Are the Sunshine of My Life
stanza: Yeah...! You are my sunshine of my life
(Love has joined us...) Baby
(Let's love sweet love...)
That's why I'll always stay around (I've found my baby!)
Can't stop, hey baby...
You are the apple...
Catherine liked high places
High up, high up on the hills
A place for making noises
Like whales
Noises like the whales
Here she built a chapel
With her image
Her image on the wall
A place where she could rest and rest
And a place where she could wash
